scope: Three-project Chinese OCR quality comparison over five deterministic CCPD2020/CCPD-Green real road-scene photos and exact annotation-box crops, plus one current ImagePlugin runtime/finalizer projection.

source.license_boundary: CC-BY-4.0 on the archived Zenodo record; the original project describes CCPD as MIT
source.selection_rule_fixed_before_execution: first five JPEG entries in lexicographic full-path order from the remote ZIP central directory; all resolve to CCPD2020/ccpd_green/test
source.remote_access_boundary: Only the ZIP central directory and five selected entries were fetched with HTTP byte ranges; the 907,711,344-byte archive was not downloaded in full.
source_characteristics: real 720x1160 RGB road or parking photographs
small green new-energy license plates with perspective, distance, illumination and background clutter
ground-truth plate labels and inclusive axis-aligned bounding boxes encoded by the official filename convention

execution_contract.docwen_ref_tk_entry: Production docwen.utils.ocr_utils.extract_text_simple with benchmark-only configured-language injection returning chinese.
execution_contract.docwen_ref_pyside6_entry: Production docwen.utils.ocr_utils.extract_text_simple with benchmark-only configured-language injection returning chinese.

input_variants.full_frame: Unmodified 720x1160 RGB source JPEG, exercising generic text detection and recognition.
input_variants.bbox_crop: Exact inclusive ground-truth axis-aligned bbox converted only to Pillow-exclusive right/bottom coordinates; no padding, resizing, enhancement or perspective correction.

quality_metric_contract.normalization: Unicode NFKC plus casefold, retaining only Unicode letters and numbers. Each label is compared with every nonempty OCR line using normalized Levenshtein similarity; the best line is used.
quality_metric_contract.threshold_purpose: A deliberately modest useful-text reachability gate for a distinct Chinese photo/perspective slice; failed gates remain failed and were not tuned after observing output.

current_runtime_projection.entry: ImagePlugin -> TaskManager -> OutputFinalizer with category format=image, input size, image_mode=file, OCR enabled, image_md placement and chinese/zh_CN

classification.reason: All ten outputs are byte-identical across the three production wrappers and all three projects use byte-identical model files. The current runtime also consumes chinese/zh_CN and finalizes the reachable OCR text. The failed photo/plate quality gates are therefore a shared model/pipeline capability boundary, not evidence of a current rewrite regression.

known_limits: Five CCPD-Green photos are a focused Chinese new-energy plate slice, not a broad Chinese document or general scene-text corpus.
The exact annotation crops are only 60-76 pixels wide and 23-28 pixels high; no post-result resizing, padding, enhancement or perspective rectification was introduced.
This does not establish handwriting, general document OCR, scanned-PDF, reading-order/layout, bounding-box accuracy, packaged-binary quality, latency or performance parity.
The failed quality thresholds remain an open shared OCR-quality boundary; they are not an accepted difference and were not converted into a PASS.
GOLDEN-004 and overall final artifact parity remain NOT PASSED YET.
